In pursuance of the provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution, the Governor is
pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification no. 1483/IX-1-2020-
33T.A. /20, dated; November 20 , 2020.
No. 1483/IX-1–2020-33T.A.-20
Dated Lucknow, November 20, 2020
The following draft notification which the Governor proposes to issue in exercise of the powers
under clause (2) of Article 243 Q of the Constitution of India read with sub-section (2) of section 3 of the
Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P.Act no-2 of 1916) and in partial modification of notification
no. 2207-T/9-1-82-31-T-80, dated May 12, 1982 and other previous notifications issued in this behalf
including the areas specified in the Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar Panchayat Tindwari
in District Banda, is hereby published for the information of all concerned and with a view to inviting
objections and suggestions in respect thereof as required under sub- section (1) of section 4 of the said Act.
2. Objections or suggestions, if any, with respect to the proposed notification should be sent in
writing addressed to the Pramukh Sachiv, Uttar Pradesh Shasan, Nagar Vikas Anubhag-1, Bapu Bhawan,
Lucknow. Only such objections and suggestions shall be taken into consideration as are received within
15 days from the date of publication of this notification in the Gazette.
Draft Notification
In exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243Q of the Constitution read with sub-
section (2) of section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. 2 of 1916), and in
partial modification of notification no. 2207-T/9-1-82-31-T-80 dated May 12, 1982 and other previous
notifications issued in this behalf from time to time the Governor is pleased to include the areas specified
in the Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar Panchayat Tindwari in District Banda for the
purposes of Part IXA of the Constitution.
